tools.description: Search for destination wedding venues worldwide. Filter by country, venue type (villa, beach, castle, resort, hotel, estate, garden, restaurant), guest capacity, and price range, and optionally leave out unverified imported listings. tools.name: search_vendors
tools.title: Search Wedding Vendors
tools.description: Search for wedding vendors by category and location. Categories include photographer, videographer, florist, caterer, DJ, band, planner, coordinator, hair & makeup, cake/bakery, officiant, rentals & decor, stationery, and transportation. Each result carries `descriptionStatus` (`generated` when Aisle wrote the listing from public information and the vendor has not claimed it, `listing_content` when the vendor manages it) `ratingSource` (`google` for a Google rating), `categorySource` (`aisle_search` when Aisle filed the business under the category of the search that found it, `listing` when the vendor manages the listing) and `websiteDomain`, the business’s own site, which often shows a listing filed under the wrong category. `priceRange` is null on a generated listing, whose band was never given by the vendor, so `price_range` matches vendor-managed listings only. `min_rating` and `min_reviews` filter on the Google rating and review count, and `sort` orders by name (default), rating or reviews; most vendors rate 4.5 or more, so the review count is usually what tells them apart. When a location search finds fewer than five vendors, `nearby` lists other locations within 150km holding vendors that match the same category, price and rating filters, with a count and the distance to the closest. A location search also gives each result `kmFromHub`, its distance from the middle of that location’s listings, because `city` names the place searched rather than the vendor’s own town. A result that shares its website or phone number with another vendor in the same category and location lists those vendors in `possibleDuplicates`, each with what they share: they may be one business listed twice, its branches, or one business under two names.
